title: Over 22 journos covering Asean protests subjected to police harassment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) documented at least 22 media workers who reported experiencing police harassment during the demonstrations on Sunday amid the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. “The arrests, attempted arrests, and harassment of protesters and journalists constitute violations of the people’s right to peaceful assembly and the media’s freedom to report on matters of public interest,” the NUJP said in a statement on Sunday. Among those affected were campus journalists from the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) Perspective, UPLB The Staple, UP Philippine Collegian, and City College of Calamba […]...
